title: SIK3 controls synaptic localization of NMDA receptors by phosphorylating GluN1
title_zh: SIK3通过磷酸化GluN1控制NMDA受体的突触定位
abstract: Synaptic NMDA-type glutamate receptors (NMDARs) are central components of all neural computations. NMDAR levels critically vary between synapses but how the synaptic localization of NMDARs is controlled remains unclear. Here we show that SIK3, a serine–threonine protein kinase, localizes to synapses where it phosphorylates the obligatory NMDAR subunit GluN1 at a single site. This single phosphorylation event controls NMDAR recruitment to synapses. Genetic deletion of SIK3 severely and selectively decreases synaptic GluN1 levels by ~60% without altering AMPA-type glutamate receptor levels or inducing major transcriptional changes. Pharmacological inhibition of SIK3 impairs synaptic NMDAR responses within 45 minutes. Mutating the SIK3-phosphorylation site inhibits GluN1 synaptic recruitment. ‘Sleepy’, a gain-of-function mutation in SIK3 that increases sleep, selectively enhances synaptic NMDAR levels by increasing GluN1 phosphorylation. Thus, SIK3 phosphorylation of GluN1 provides a key signal for recruiting NMDARs to synapses. SIK3 kinase controls synaptic NMDA receptor recruitment by phosphorylating GluN1 at a single site. Loss or inhibition of SIK3 markedly reduces synaptic NMDARs, while a gain-of-function mutation increases GluN1 phosphorylation and NMDAR levels.
abstract_zh: 突触NMDA型谷氨酸受体（NMDAR）是所有神经计算的核心组成部分。突触之间NMDAR水平的差异至关重要，但突触NMDAR定位的控制机制仍不清楚。本研究显示，丝氨酸-苏氨酸蛋白激酶SIK3定位于突触，并磷酸化必需的NMDAR亚基GluN1于单一位点。这一单一磷酸化事件控制NMDAR的突触招募。SIK3基因敲除显著且选择性地降低突触GluN1水平约60%，而不改变α-氨基-3-羟基-5-甲基-4-异丙酸受体水平或诱导主要转录变化。SIK3的药理抑制在45分钟内损害突触NMDAR反应。突变SIK3磷酸化位点会抑制GluN1的突触招募。“睡眠”，SIK3获得功能突变可增加睡眠，通过增加GluN1磷酸化选择性增强突触NMDAR水平。因此，SIK3对GluN1的磷酸化是将NMDAR招募到突触的关键信号。SIK3激酶通过磷酸化GluN1于单一位点控制突触NMDA受体的招募。SIK3的丢失或抑制显著减少突触NMDAR，而获得功能突变则增加GluN1磷酸化和NMDAR水平。
